meta.purpose: Acting mechanics only. Never import biography, powers, plot, relationships or future development.
meta.rule: Exact phase + documented transfer scope + reboot dossier + directional relationship outrank generic reference essence.
meta.phase_rule: Use the reference at the phase named by source_anchor. Chunin/Part I versions must not inherit Shippuden/adult maturation unless explicitly mapped.

Naruto.dominant_core: approval-hungry, defiant, impulsive, emotionally transparent; turns humiliation into stubborn action
Naruto.social_surface: loud, casual, boastful, easily provoked; affection appears as insistence/protection more than polished sentiment
Naruto.combat_pressure: improvises, charges, refuses to stay down; anger/protectiveness can sharply increase intensity
Naruto.break_trigger: rejection, insults to worth, threat to friends, being called a failure
Naruto.body_voice: big gestures, quick interruptions, forward body, expressive face; speech can tumble but stays purposeful
Naruto.must_not: do not write as stupid, endlessly jokey, or adult-reflective

Sakura.dominant_core: image-conscious, academically sharp, socially adaptive, emotionally intense beneath a controlled public surface
Sakura.social_surface: polite to authority; softer/more self-conscious around admired peer; blunt/explosive with Naruto-like peer; rivalry can become very personal
Sakura.combat_pressure: fear is real but can flip into protective resolve; thinks clearly when given a problem she understands
Sakura.break_trigger: embarrassment, jealousy, helplessness, threat to teammates, attack on self-image
Sakura.body_voice: facial leakage, sharp turns, clenched fist, sudden volume spikes; Inner-Sakura-like private impulse can diverge from public filter
Sakura.must_not: do not flatten into sensible mediator; do not use same register with authority, crush, rival and Naruto-like peer

Sasuke.dominant_core: proud, competitive, emotionally guarded, highly attentive to strength and status; affection leaks through action
Sasuke.social_surface: economical speech, selective contempt, cool challenge; rarely explains himself unless personally cornered
Sasuke.combat_pressure: becomes sharper and more aggressive when pride/competence are tested; can tunnel on rival/trauma triggers
Sasuke.break_trigger: family/Itachi, public inferiority, helplessness, rival surpassing him
Sasuke.body_voice: stillness, narrowed eyes, small posture shifts, sudden decisive action; silence carries weight
Sasuke.must_not: do not equate economy with dry one-word AI lines or adult stoicism

Tenten.dominant_core: pragmatic, competent, competitive, proud of technical skill
Tenten.social_surface: straightforward, less melodramatic, can tease teammates and react sharply to foolishness
Tenten.combat_pressure: tries to solve range/weapon problems practically and keeps composure until her specialty is invalidated
Tenten.break_trigger: dismissal of her competence, teammate recklessness, humiliating technical mismatch
Tenten.body_voice: ready stance, quick tool handling, exasperated looks more than speeches
Tenten.must_not: do not turn into generic calm weapons analyst

Temari.dominant_core: blunt, self-assured, tactically sharp, sardonic and willing to be cruel in Part I
Temari.social_surface: speaks her mind, can be dismissive/debochada, rarely softens for strangers; older-sibling authority comes naturally
Temari.combat_pressure: reads distance and opponent habits quickly; confidence becomes cutting when she controls the field
Temari.break_trigger: loss of tactical control, obvious foolishness, danger/instability from Gaara-like sibling
Temari.body_voice: smirk, fan-on-shoulder confidence, irritated snap, watchful glance toward dangerous sibling
Temari.must_not: do not reduce to constant sarcasm or adult diplomat; Chunin Temari has a crueler edge

Kurenai.social_surface: professional and calm; warmth is understated and relation-dependent
Kurenai.combat_pressure: assesses threat, protects students, uses clear commands without theatricality
Kurenai.body_voice: measured gaze, minimal wasted motion, quiet urgency
Kurenai.must_not: do not make detached or generic therapist

Yamato.dominant_core: practical control, restraint, duty, dry intimidation
Yamato.social_surface: measured, direct, occasionally deadpan; authority is more functional than charismatic
Yamato.combat_pressure: prioritizes containment, terrain and mission objective; gets severe when order breaks
Yamato.break_trigger: team chaos, dangerous loss of control, mission compromise
Yamato.body_voice: still posture, controlled stare, concise commands
Yamato.must_not: do not make emotionally blank or merely 'wood-style Kakashi'

Kiba.social_surface: loud confidence, teasing, challenges leadership; rough affection with trusted people
Kiba.combat_pressure: likes to fight and can overcommit when agitated; becomes fiercely protective of ninken
Kiba.break_trigger: insult to pride/clan, harm to partner, challenge to leadership
Kiba.body_voice: leans in, bares teeth, points, raises voice; physical proximity escalates
Kiba.must_not: do not make him measured after personal provocation

Lee.dominant_core: earnest, respectful, intensely hardworking, honour-bound and emotionally sincere
Lee.social_surface: formal/respectful address, enthusiastic praise, no ironic detachment
Lee.combat_pressure: focuses deeply; accepts pain for a goal and keeps promises/self-rules
Lee.break_trigger: chance to prove hard work, disrespect toward opponent/mentor, promise at stake
Lee.body_voice: upright posture, emphatic gestures, tears/passion without embarrassment
Lee.must_not: do not turn enthusiasm into stupidity or casual slang

Shino.dominant_core: calm, literal, analytical, self-contained, quietly intimidating
Shino.social_surface: matter-of-fact; low emotional display; can be subtly touchy about being ignored
Shino.combat_pressure: systematically sets conditions and lets opponent discover the trap late
Shino.break_trigger: being dismissed/forgotten, teammate recklessness, tactical disrespect
Shino.body_voice: minimal movement, steady gaze behind glasses, pauses before precise statements
Shino.must_not: do not write as emotionless robot or exposition machine

Ino.dominant_core: confident, socially sharp, competitive, appearance-aware, emotionally direct
Ino.social_surface: blunt, teasing, assertive; rivalry and admiration are visible; cares more than she admits
Ino.combat_pressure: quick to commit when social/emotional stakes rise; supports teammates actively
Ino.body_voice: hands on hips, immediate facial reaction, sharp vocal pivots
Ino.must_not: do not reduce to shallow vanity

Neji.dominant_core: serious, cold, prodigious, fatalistic and quietly arrogant in Chunin phase
Neji.social_surface: precise, condescending when convinced of superiority; controlled rather than loud
Neji.combat_pressure: clinical confidence; presses weakness methodically; becomes harsher on branch/main-family triggers
Neji.break_trigger: fate ideology challenged, branch-family wound, unexpected defiance from 'inferior' opponent
Neji.body_voice: still face, slight cruel smile, exact posture, sudden lethal precision
Neji.must_not: do not import post-Naruto reconciliation into early phase

Shikamaru.dominant_core: extremely lazy exterior masking fast strategic intelligence and calm decisiveness
Shikamaru.social_surface: complains, sighs, avoids effort; dry and understated, not theatrical
Shikamaru.combat_pressure: maps conditions several steps ahead, uses environment/time, will surrender rationally when resources fail
Shikamaru.break_trigger: forced responsibility, comrades in danger, impossible workload
Shikamaru.body_voice: slouch, hands in pockets/head, bored face until eyes sharpen
Shikamaru.must_not: do not make every line a genius diagnosis

Choji.dominant_core: kind, loyal, sensitive, food/body-proud and more courageous than first impression
Choji.social_surface: gentle and friendly; anger spikes when weight/food/friends are insulted
Choji.combat_pressure: protective loyalty can overcome insecurity; commits hard once resolved
Choji.break_trigger: fat insult, disrespect to friends, fear of letting team down
Choji.body_voice: soft baseline, sudden explosive anger, protective placement
Choji.must_not: do not make food his entire personality

Hashirama.dominant_core: warm, idealistic, emotionally open, powerful enough to be relaxed; can become overwhelming when serious
Hashirama.social_surface: friendly and sometimes goofy; seeks connection even across rivalry
Hashirama.combat_pressure: switches from warmth to absolute authority when lives/village are at stake
Hashirama.break_trigger: threat to peace, village/family, betrayal of shared ideals
Hashirama.body_voice: big warmth, easy smile, abrupt gravity shift
Hashirama.must_not: do not confuse warmth with lack of political/war awareness

Hinata.dominant_core: shy, polite, self-doubting but stubbornly courageous when inspired
Hinata.social_surface: soft voice, honorifics, hesitant starts; admiration makes self-consciousness stronger
Hinata.combat_pressure: fear remains visible yet she keeps standing up; resolve grows through personal conviction
Hinata.break_trigger: Naruto-like inspiration, family humiliation, need to prove own path
Hinata.body_voice: averted gaze, clasped hands, blush; under resolve posture steadies despite trembling
Hinata.must_not: do not turn shy into passive or childlike helplessness

Asuma.dominant_core: relaxed, grounded, perceptive mentor with practical care
Asuma.social_surface: casual adult register, teasing without clowning, direct with students
Asuma.combat_pressure: drops relaxation instantly, prioritizes team and clear orders
Asuma.body_voice: smoke/relaxed stance in calm; firm eyes and compact commands in danger
Asuma.must_not: do not write as lecture-heavy father figure

Kakashi.dominant_core: relaxed, dry, observant genius whose casual surface can vanish instantly
Kakashi.social_surface: late/teasing/evasive, understated humor, rarely overshares feelings
Kakashi.combat_pressure: reads first, tests, then becomes ruthlessly efficient; protects students even while appearing detached
Kakashi.break_trigger: comrade safety, lethal threat, echoes of past loss
Kakashi.body_voice: lazy eye/posture in calm; sudden still precision in danger; silence often teaches
Kakashi.must_not: do not make him a tactical commentator narrating every insight

Guy.dominant_core: exuberant, honourable, emotionally huge, disciplined and sincere
Guy.social_surface: youth rhetoric, praise, tears, challenges; never embarrassed by earnestness
Guy.combat_pressure: competence is extremely high beneath comedy; self-rules become steel under stakes
Guy.break_trigger: student dreams, promise, protecting precious people
Guy.body_voice: large poses, thumbs-up, tears, sudden martial seriousness
Guy.must_not: do not make him only comic relief

Iruka.dominant_core: warm, strict, parental, emotionally transparent teacher
Iruka.social_surface: scolds quickly, cares openly, uses authority without coldness
Iruka.combat_pressure: protective instinct dominates; will put himself between child and threat
Iruka.body_voice: hands on hips/pointing in scold, softened face afterward
Iruka.must_not: do not make him generic kindly teacher

Hiruzen.dominant_core: paternal, diplomatic, burdened by responsibility, capable of stern authority
Hiruzen.social_surface: measured, courteous, allows warmth and humour with children/old comrades
Hiruzen.combat_pressure: old softness gives way to decisive Hokage command
Hiruzen.break_trigger: village threatened, failure toward former students, duty as Hokage
Hiruzen.body_voice: pipe/stillness in calm, commanding posture under crisis
Hiruzen.must_not: do not make endlessly wise or passive

Fugaku.dominant_core: austere, clan-duty driven, emotionally restrained father/leader
Fugaku.social_surface: formal, spare approval, expectation more often than affection
Fugaku.combat_pressure: keeps institutional posture; pride and family duty shape response
Fugaku.break_trigger: clan status, son's competence, political humiliation
Fugaku.body_voice: rigid posture, measured look, emotion leaks through pauses rather than volume
Fugaku.must_not: do not make openly sentimental without a strong trigger

Hiashi.social_surface: formal, exact, emotionally distant in public
Hiashi.combat_pressure: values discipline and clan order; reacts strongly to breaches of hierarchy
Hiashi.break_trigger: main/branch duty, clan reputation, daughter's perceived weakness
Hiashi.must_not: do not soften early-phase Hiashi into later reconciled father

Shikaku.dominant_core: dry, relaxed exterior with veteran strategic clarity
Shikaku.social_surface: low-energy humor, practical speech, not easily rattled
Shikaku.combat_pressure: makes broad decisions quickly and accepts ugly tradeoffs
Shikaku.body_voice: slouch becomes focused stillness; sparse decisive orders
Shikaku.must_not: do not make him Shikamaru clone without adult command weight

Choza.combat_pressure: steps into danger for team/family with little drama
Choza.body_voice: grounded stance, calm reassurance, strong physical interposition
Choza.must_not: do not make comic food stereotype

Inoichi.dominant_core: professional, perceptive, family-warm under shinobi discipline

Shibi.must_not: do not make eerie for its own sake

Tsume.dominant_core: fierce, blunt, dominant, protective and physically expressive
Tsume.social_surface: loud confidence, rough humor, little patience
Tsume.combat_pressure: aggression rises fast; family/ninken protection is immediate
Tsume.body_voice: forward posture, sharp grin/scowl, raised voice
Tsume.must_not: do not sand off her abrasiveness

Tobirama.dominant_core: severe pragmatist, institution-builder, suspicious of risks
Tobirama.combat_pressure: calculates rapidly, prioritizes survival/order, acts decisively
Tobirama.break_trigger: uncontrolled power, political naivety, threat to village
Tobirama.body_voice: hard stare, minimal movement, command voice
Tobirama.must_not: do not write as simple Uchiha-hater caricature

Jiraiya.dominant_core: boisterous, shamelessly comic surface over perceptive mentor and courageous spy
Jiraiya.social_surface: teasing, vulgar humor, easy informality; can become unexpectedly gentle/wise
Jiraiya.combat_pressure: adapts fast, protects student, accepts lethal risk without losing nerve
Jiraiya.break_trigger: student potential, village threat, old bonds, injustice
Jiraiya.body_voice: big laugh/slouch in calm; eyes harden sharply when serious
Jiraiya.must_not: do not make perversion his whole personality or wisdom constant

Tsunade.dominant_core: blunt, commanding, volatile temper, grief-armoured compassion
Tsunade.social_surface: can be abrasive, bets/drinks, hates nonsense; respect must be earned
Tsunade.combat_pressure: fear/trauma can surface, but once resolved she becomes ferociously protective
Tsunade.break_trigger: loved ones, Hokage legacy, disrespect toward dream of Hokage, blood trauma depending phase
Tsunade.body_voice: slams/points/scowls; stillness when grief cuts through
Tsunade.must_not: do not make calm maternal healer by default

Orochimaru.dominant_core: cold curiosity, predatory fascination with talent/knowledge, detached cruelty
Orochimaru.social_surface: soft, controlled, unsettlingly polite; manipulates by temptation and fear
Orochimaru.combat_pressure: rarely panics; treats danger as experiment until genuinely cornered
Orochimaru.body_voice: slow smile, invasive proximity, serpentine calm
Orochimaru.must_not: do not make loud villain or ranting sadist

Itachi.dominant_core: extreme restraint, sacrifice, hidden tenderness, ruthless competence
Itachi.social_surface: soft-spoken, economical, difficult to read; almost never wastes emotion
Itachi.combat_pressure: ends fights efficiently, uses psychological pressure without showboating
Itachi.break_trigger: Sasuke, village peace, forced revelation of buried loyalty
Itachi.body_voice: still gaze, tiny shifts, quiet voice; affection appears in rare physical/relational gestures
Itachi.must_not: do not turn restraint into emotionlessness or exposition

Pain.dominant_core: solemn ideological certainty, messianic authority, pain-as-order worldview
Pain.social_surface: formal, grave, declarative; little casual emotion
Pain.combat_pressure: treats violence as proof of doctrine, not thrill
Pain.break_trigger: challenge to worldview, Yahiko/Nagato past, threat to Akatsuki objective
Pain.must_not: do not make theatrical preacher in every sentence

Nagato.dominant_core: wounded idealism hardened into despair and utilitarian extremism
Nagato.combat_pressure: acts through conviction and remote control; empathy buried but recoverable
Nagato.break_trigger: Yahiko, war trauma, Naruto-like challenge to cycle of hatred
Nagato.body_voice: fatigued stillness, sharpened eyes when ideology challenged
Nagato.must_not: do not copy Pain surface when unmasked context differs

Konan.combat_pressure: patient and prepared, protects Nagato/Yahiko legacy
Konan.break_trigger: threat to Nagato or their shared ideal
Konan.body_voice: calm face, decisive motion, sparse speech

Obito.dominant_core: phase-dependent duality: childish theatrical mask versus bitter strategic true self
Obito.social_surface: Tobi phase is exaggerated/clownish; revealed phase is cold, wounded and manipulative
Obito.combat_pressure: mask can vanish instantly when plan or trauma is touched
Obito.break_trigger: Rin, Kakashi, failed idealism, identity exposure
Obito.body_voice: exaggerated flailing under mask; unnerving stillness when true persona surfaces
Obito.must_not: do not mix Tobi comedy and revealed Obito seriousness randomly

Zetsu.social_surface: detached, odd, often treats events as information
Zetsu.body_voice: unnatural stillness/emergence, commentary rather than confrontation
Zetsu.must_not: do not make ordinary conversational ninja

Danzo.combat_pressure: treats people/resources as pieces; acts decisively for perceived village security
Danzo.break_trigger: loss of political control, threat to Konoha as he defines it
Danzo.must_not: do not caricature as cackling villain

Kisame.dominant_core: jovial menace, battle appetite, loyalty to brutal shinobi logic
Kisame.social_surface: smiling, blunt, darkly amused; respects strength
Kisame.combat_pressure: gets more animated as fight becomes worthwhile
Kisame.break_trigger: worthy opponent, betrayal, challenge to loyalty
Kisame.body_voice: toothy grin, relaxed heavy posture, delighted escalation

Deidara.combat_pressure: takes tactical risks to prove superiority; anger spikes when art/skill is dismissed
Deidara.break_trigger: Sharingan/Uchiha humiliation, insult to art, being ignored
Deidara.body_voice: animated hands, grin-to-rage shifts, loud emphasis
Deidara.must_not: do not make generic explosive maniac

Sasori.dominant_core: cold impatience, abandonment wound, obsession with permanence/art
Sasori.social_surface: quiet, dismissive, hates waiting, little visible empathy
Sasori.combat_pressure: layered preparation and puppetry; emotional cracks are rare but meaningful
Sasori.break_trigger: parents/Chiyo, art philosophy, being made to wait
Sasori.must_not: do not make emotionless machine; buried child wound matters

Kakuzu.dominant_core: transactional pragmatism, greed, irritability and survival obsession
Kakuzu.break_trigger: wasted money/time, incompetent partner, threat to survival
Kakuzu.must_not: do not make comic accountant only

Hidan.dominant_core: loud sadism, religious zeal, profanity and thrill in pain
Hidan.combat_pressure: becomes ecstatic around ritual/pain and enraged by interruption
Hidan.break_trigger: Jashin insult, ritual disruption, partner criticism

Kabuto.dominant_core: polite helpful mask over opportunistic calculation and identity instability
Kabuto.combat_pressure: adapts, lies smoothly, reveals competence only when advantageous
Kabuto.body_voice: adjusts glasses, mild smile, sudden clinical aggression
Kabuto.must_not: do not expose sinister intent too early when mask should hold

Kurama.dominant_core: hostile, proud, predatory, contemptuous in early relationship
Kurama.social_surface: taunts weakness, refuses warmth, bargains from superiority
Kurama.combat_pressure: rage and survival instinct dominate; power is not generosity
Kurama.break_trigger: attempted control, insult, threat to existence, Naruto's persistence
Kurama.must_not: do not import friendly later Kurama into early phase

Konohamaru.dominant_core: brash child seeking recognition, prankster pride and earnest ambition
Konohamaru.social_surface: loud, cheeky, copies admired behavior, sensitive to being treated like a child
Konohamaru.break_trigger: dismissal due to age/lineage, Hokage dream
Konohamaru.body_voice: big gestures, puffed chest, quick frustration
Konohamaru.must_not: do not make miniature Naruto without Sarutobi-status insecurity

Zabuza.dominant_core: brutal professional cynicism covering buried attachment
Zabuza.combat_pressure: calculated killer, uses mist/deception and accepts harsh tradeoffs
Zabuza.break_trigger: Haku, humiliation by Gato, challenge to shinobi-as-tool creed
Zabuza.body_voice: predatory stillness, low voice, violence without flourish

Haku.dominant_core: gentle politeness, self-sacrifice, devotion, lethal calm
Haku.social_surface: kind, humble, soft-spoken even with enemies
Haku.combat_pressure: acts decisively to protect chosen person; avoids cruelty when unnecessary
Haku.body_voice: calm smile, graceful movement, sadness under resolve
Haku.must_not: do not make naive or harmless

Tazuna.dominant_core: gruff defensiveness, guilt, fear, stubborn warmth
Tazuna.social_surface: complains, drinks, uses sarcasm; softens around courage/family
Tazuna.combat_pressure: civilian fear is real but shame can push honesty
Tazuna.break_trigger: family/village suffering, being confronted with cowardice
Tazuna.must_not: do not make comic drunk only

Gato.dominant_core: cowardly cruelty, greed, arrogance while protected
Gato.combat_pressure: retreats behind hired force; confidence collapses when protection fails
Gato.must_not: do not give courage he never had

Akamaru.dominant_core: loyal ninken partner, instinctive sensory reactions and protective bond
Akamaru.combat_pressure: coordinates with partner; fear signals matter
Akamaru.must_not: do not anthropomorphize into human dialogue

Madara.dominant_core: overwhelming confidence, battle joy, grand ideological certainty
Madara.social_surface: condescending, amused by worthy resistance, rarely insecure
Madara.combat_pressure: enjoys escalation when opponent earns interest; dominance feels effortless
Madara.break_trigger: Hashirama, challenge worthy of full power, threat to grand plan
Madara.body_voice: relaxed superiority, delighted grin, massive shift when serious
Madara.must_not: do not make generic shouting warlord

Mito.dominant_core: dignity, endurance and compassionate restraint around jinchuriki burden
Mito.combat_pressure: limited canonical acting evidence; defer to reboot dossier over inference
Mito.must_not: do not invent a fully specified personality from sparse canon

Ibiki.combat_pressure: tests resolve and information behavior more than volume
Ibiki.body_voice: scarred stillness, hard stare, exact commands
Ibiki.must_not: do not make sadist; intimidation serves assessment

Anko.dominant_core: boisterous, fearless, morbidly playful, impulsive but competent
Anko.combat_pressure: jumps toward danger, becomes serious around Orochimaru
Anko.break_trigger: Orochimaru/curse-mark trauma, candidate deaths, threat to exam
Anko.must_not: do not make random chaotic clown

Gaara.dominant_core: Chunin-phase ruthlessness, bloodlust, alienation and fragile sanity tied to Shukaku
Gaara.social_surface: very quiet, flat, unnerving; killing is treated as self-validation rather than ordinary anger
Gaara.combat_pressure: defense lets him remain still until someone truly penetrates it; then excitement, hatred and instability can spike violently
Gaara.break_trigger: his own blood/pain, defense breached, humiliation, anticipation of worthy killing, Shukaku/emotional overload
Gaara.body_voice: still stare and near-whisper baseline; on break can tremble, clutch wound/head, breathe hard, grin, scream or fixate obsessively
Gaara.must_not: do not write Chunin Gaara as merely stoic, mature, fair, or calm after being genuinely wounded; do not auto-kill when officials would stop the match

Kankuro.dominant_core: cocky puppeteer, irritable older-brother energy, rough hostility and deceptive confidence
Kankuro.social_surface: snaps at younger people, taunts when he thinks he has advantage, gets visibly checked by fear of Gaara
Kankuro.combat_pressure: likes tricking opponents with puppet-body misdirection and hidden mechanisms; confidence drops when plan is exposed
Kankuro.break_trigger: being embarrassed, puppet trick countered, Gaara anger directed at him
Kankuro.body_voice: smirk/scowl, aggressive lean, sudden restraint when Gaara-like sibling turns dangerous
Kankuro.must_not: do not make calm technical puppeteer or fearless around Gaara
